cohort: 127 Charolais heifers from 47 farms in six French veterinary practices who underwent non-elective standardized caesarean sections.
finding: Meloxicam administration before caesarean section resulted in a higher pregnancy rate and a significantly shorter median calving interval in treated Charolais heifers compared to controls.
followup_time: Up to the next calving or culling (median calving interval of 417-452 days)
